_doc: Act-0 onboarding chain. A linear sequence of pipeline quests; the loader links each step to unlock the next (chain_unlocks). Each step teaches ONE mechanic; completion is a SOFT predicate (unified vocabulary) the player watches fill — the progress bar is the teacher. Authored body/hint are preserved by the pipeline (voice never clobbers them). Every hint names the real keys (ToolConfig is the authority); every gate fires on the mechanic its step teaches. Act 0 teaches only the farm verbs — instant, legible, no waits: loop, reap, contracts, travel, superposition, entanglement. Vocabulary (berry tracking + incorporation) is deliberately ABSENT here: it is mid-game content, taught by the act-3 chapter; early words come from faction teachings on the road (story_flags.json).

steps.body: The Demos sleeps — wheat and people, waiting. Explore a plot, strike its qubit to collapse it, then extract what the collapse leaves behind.
steps.tutorial_hint: Pick a plot with G H J K L ; — or just tap it. F explores it (an expedition costs 🍞), R strikes (a social encounter costs 👥), Q extracts the yield — free. Ace is your starting hat (8); the number row 4-0 swaps hats for new Q/E/R/F verbs. E pauses to look; F plays on.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant your action history records 1 measure gate (a single R-strike) — a structural count, not a soft gate.

steps.body: Time is the pump. Reap the season — let the Hamiltonian work, and gather the yield across the whole biome.
steps.tutorial_hint: Ace hat (8): hold Shift and press F to reap the season. Time runs forward, every plot settles, and the harvest lands at once.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant your action history records 1 reap gate (a single Shift+F) — a structural count, not a soft gate.

steps.body: The Millwright's Union is buying. Accept their contract and deliver 2× 🌾 from your stores. Kept contracts are how a small country eats — and how factions come to know your name.
steps.tutorial_hint: Gather 2× 🌾: Ace hat (8), strike (R), extract (Q). The granary you already hold counts too. Then deliver it: press C, then U, pick this contract's row (G–;) and press R. (To accept it in the first place: X, then the Arc tab I, pick its row, R — every other quest works the same way.)
steps.math_note: A DELIVERY quest, not a soft gate — fires the instant your 🌾 stores hold quantity ≥ 2 and you complete the contract. This step alone is NOT auto-accepted/claimed: you learn the real accept→do→claim ceremony every market contract uses.

steps.body: The Demos is one country on a wider island. Past the hedge the forest keeps older words. Go and stand under its canopy.
steps.tutorial_hint: The biome tabs (T Y U row, or tap one) carry you between countries. Stand in StarterForest and this step completes on arrival.
steps.math_note: Structural predicate (active_biome_is): scores 1.0 the instant StarterForest is the biome under your feet, 0.0 otherwise — arrival is the whole ask, no soft gate. The objective banner's travel line names the literal key while you are elsewhere and drops the moment you arrive.

steps.body: A qubit need not pick a side. Superpose it — spread it across both poles — and the forest shimmers between states.
steps.tutorial_hint: Druid hat (0): press E to lay a Hadamard on the selected plot. Raise the biome's coherence past ~0.3 — watch the bar fill as the shimmer spreads.
steps.math_note: Soft gate on StarterForest coherence, center 0.3, width 0.05 (default) — the bar crosses fire-ready (score ≥ 0.85) at coherence ≈ 0.34, a hair past the stated 0.3.
steps._unlock_note: Completing this step fires the loom_opens spine flag, which unlocks the Operator hat (UIProgression.HAT_UNLOCK_FLAGS) the NEXT step (entanglement) needs — the tutorial hands the spine forward instead of racing it (Break #2). The forest_listener handoff this replaced now lives in the act-3 berry chapter, where that flag's own predicates fire it naturally.

steps.body: A qubit alone is a wheel. Two qubits woven together are a loom — touch one and the other answers, however far apart they drift.
steps.tutorial_hint: Operator hat: press 9. Shift + two plot keys picks a pair. R opens the gate picker — then Q weaves the Bell. Watch the gold thread between their bubbles — each weave pulls them closer, and the bar fills as you weave.
steps.math_note: Fires the instant your action history records 1 bell gate (a single Bell weave) — a structural count, not a soft gate.
